about: The look library behind the Create page's look picker: grouped prompt fragments, one per group. Lighting, colour, framing, focus, quality and aspect words are the studio's own vocabulary lists, rewritten for prompts with anything suggestive removed. Camera, lens, era, palette, light and motion fragments come from the studio's director kit (101 fragments, deliberately strong so the choice shows on a fixed seed). The picture and video styles are the safe-for-work halves of the studio's own style lists. Our own wording throughout.
